text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 森林童话 · 林间小屋 · 纯环境.
Environment: An empty cozy cottage interior at a forest clearing, limewashed walls, pale oak beams, linen sofa, stone hearth without a roaring fire, a round window framing soft green trees and tiny white flowers, a ceramic tea pot on a weathered table. Soft luminous woodland morning, believable warm wood and handmade cloth; dreamy but not cartoon, no mushrooms as furniture. Premium dimensional 3D romance game environment, airy dreamlike quality, physically tactile materials, pearl white stone, restrained fine silver and warm wood, soft lavender/seafoam accents, broad soft light, luminous exposure preserving texture, low contrast shadows, very subtle halation. Elegant, intimate and spatially plausible, not a cluttered game splash art, not dark or greasy. Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Use case: spatial production design. Create 三维图 for 森林童话 · 林间小屋 · 纯环境. Image 1 is the geometric source of truth. Image 2 is original material and style reference. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Keep the plan footprint, doors, windows, fixed landmarks and circulation exactly consistent. Concept reconstruction, not measured construction. Match original color palette and rendering style, detailed legible clean image, landscape. NO people, animals, silhouettes or figures on posters. No fake measurements, no watermarks.
